title:
HDB loan or bank loan:
*the cash you need*

lines.say: You're buying a 600,000 dollar HDB flat. One choice decides if you need 30,000 dollars in cash.
With an HDB loan, the 25% downpayment, 150,000 dollars, can all come from CPF.
With a bank loan, it's also 25%, but at least 5% must be cash.
Useful so far? Follow for more.
That's 30,000 dollars from your bank account, not your CPF.
And once you leave an HDB loan for a bank, you can't switch back.

caption:
Buying a $600,000 HDB flat? One choice decides if you need $30,000 in cash. 🏦

With an HDB loan, the 25% downpayment, $150,000, can all come from CPF. With a bank loan, it's also 25%, but at least 5% must be cash: $30,000 from your bank account, not your CPF. And once you leave an HDB loan for a bank, you can't switch back.

Useful info? Follow for more 👇

75% loan limit from 20 Aug 2024. Illustration only.
